def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    # Use log-scale of remaining space (shifted to avoid log(0)), favoring bins with moderate leftover space
    priorities[valid] = np.log(1 + remaining[valid] + 1e-10)
    # Invert the score so smaller remaining space (better fit) gets higher priority
    priorities[valid] = -priorities[valid]
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    # Mask out bins that cannot fit the item
    valid = remaining_capacity >= 0
    # Initialize priorities with zeros
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    # For valid bins, compute priority as inverse of absolute deviation from optimal remaining capacity (item size)
    optimal_remaining = item  # Ideal remaining space after placing item
    deviations = np.abs(remaining_capacity[valid] - optimal_remaining)
    # Avoid division by zero; add small epsilon
    priorities[valid] = 1.0 / (deviations + 1e-8)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    target_fill_ratio = 0.7
    target_remaining = bins * (1 - target_fill_ratio)
    distance = np.abs(remaining[valid] - target_remaining[valid])
    priorities[valid] = 1 / (distance + 1e-10)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    current_load = bins - (bins - item).clip(min=0)
    utilization_ratio = current_load / bins
    # Favor bins with utilization ratio closest to 0.5
    distance_from_half = np.abs(utilization_ratio - 0.5)
    # Higher priority for bins closer to half-full
    return 1.0 / (distance_from_half + 1e-8)
